label: Post-production removal profile
term: post-production or post-use removal with a fixed causal task
definition: Profile fixes an arbitrary preordered time carrier, generation/instrument-history edges, completion dates, observation, baseline presence and task states, other operating conditions, and intervention-indexed removal times, retained presence, conditions and response states. Admissible is the explicit conjunction of historical time precedence, post-completion removal before observation, removal of the predecessor, retained later member and unchanged other operating conditions. State.enabled records capacity; State.execution is an optional task-execution token carrying evidence enabled=true. Capacity is enabled=true and Exercise means the execution token is present. No well-foundedness, first history, transitivity of causal links, admissible-domain nonemptiness, response uniqueness or causal applicability is assumed.
note: Analyst interpretation, attribution deferred. Generation and successive hammers motivate distinct Kind constructors; historical edges, completion dates, state classifications and operating-condition measurements are primitive interpreted data. No free adequacy or independence flag occurs. The execution certificate is the explicit state-consistency interpretation supporting exerciseCapacity, not independent proof that every metaphysical capacity has this representation. All conditions are indexed by the retained member; which conditions count as OTHER, and whether the supplied interventions exhaust physically/metaphysically admissible removals, remain OPEN. Integer controls have no first historical member for either kind. No dense-time or first-moment model is claimed. Root target STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-MOVER-SERIES still needs an exact MovesAsMoved bridge and independent accessibility warrant.
